name: Mojo ryzhee schast'e
source: This story is about a guy whose life took an unexpected turn. Because of his views on life, which oppose those of society, he becomes antisocial, withdrawn, and gloomy. Despite his rather brilliant graduation from school, he turns from a promising drummer into someone with no inspirations or goals. It's always easier to go with the flow than to swim against it, right? But once he falls asleep on the bus, he wakes up in an entirely different place. A place that can restore his faith in himself and in his own happiness.
translation: 这个故事讲述的是一个人的生活发生了意想不到的转变。由于他的人生观与社会观相反，他变得反社会、孤僻、阴郁。尽管他以相当出色的成绩毕业，但他从一个有前途的鼓手变成了一个没有灵感或目标的人。随波逐流总是比逆流而上更容易，对吧？但一旦他在公交车上睡着了，他就会在一个完全不同的地方醒来。一个可以恢复他对自己和自己幸福的信心的地方。
